name: com.likeminds.likemindschat.media.util.MediaAudioForegroundService
description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 starts this foreground service when an audio or voice attachment is played. It plays the selected recording, keeps playback active with a notification, and reports progress to the chat screen.
disableEffect: Voice messages and audio attachments can no longer play through LikeMinds Chat-v1.
